scope: Prepare bounded register/raw XYZ observation within existing AWT diagnostic session; no hardware operation
capability_choice: Continue native LSM6DS3TR-C AWT path. No software pose recognition, new algorithm, IRQ/AON/display wake or UI change. Source84h root cause and exact physical die identity remain unknown

references.correction: Section2.2: WRIST_TILT_IA55h axis indication is not applicable when using one axis side only. Previous axes00 in a single-semi-axis experiment is not independently anomalous
references.format: CTRL3_C BDU40h/IF_INC04h/BLE02h; require44h for known format. OUT_X_L28h..OUT_Z_H2dh are signed16bit little-endian; XL20h is26Hz +/-2g,0.061mg/LSB
references.freshness: AN5130 output-data/BDU sections: read STATUS XLDA before XYZ. BDU ensures per-axis L/H pairing, not simultaneous XYZ; no atomic relation to AXES/SOURCE
references.bus_source: Locked SDK i2c_core.c rt_i2c_mem_read forwards requested count; drv_i2c.c memory read forwards msg.len to HAL, supporting one6-byte raw read. Transfer success is not an independent physical bytes-received measurement

implementation.phases: before: new reads before AWT writes; running: latest polling frame; after: new reads only after successful stop/clear/restore. Idempotent stop preserves original after frame
implementation.order: BANK, require exact0; WHO,XL,CTRL3,CTRL10,PULSE,TAP,STATUS,RAW6 at28h,AXES55h,SOURCE54h. No diagnostic bank switching
implementation.interpretation: Valid bits mean completed transfers, not matching config or freshness. attempted distinguishes an absent frame; timestamps bound sequential reads. xyz_valid requires RAW/XL/CTRL3 valid and20h/44h; ready requires STATUS valid and XLDA1. Unknown/failed fields printed as0 must not be interpreted without masks
implementation.source_side_effect: SOURCE read clears latch. Before does so explicitly; running uses exactly one SOURCE read for both frame and observations. After is a fresh read after original cleanup clear. Existing summary source remains last successful running observation, never silently replaced by after
implementation.failure: Incomplete before/active frame or known config mismatch terminates diagnostic and cleans up. If hardware stop already verified, after telemetry failure leaves partial valid bits/io_errors but does not reacquire active-device responsibility
implementation.budget: At most11 read transactions per frame, each existing50ms bus timeout. Full frame may complete before cancellation/deadline is rechecked; crossed frame never increments observations.100ms remains requested event wait, not exact sample period. No free-running extra reader or thread
implementation.status: wf_wrist status copies synchronized cached snapshot and prints3 historical summary lines plus4 lines for each stage; no hardware reads
